selective_support.definition: macro over m in {0,2,4,8}, relative to StaticMix
selective_support.draft_rule: >= 3% relative macro E-AURC improvement OR >= 1pp macro RER@50 gain versus StaticMix; otherwise the result is labelled AUROC-ONLY METHOD SIGNAL

interpretation.adaptive_better_than_static: delta_macro(Adaptive-Static) > 0 with CI_low > 0 -> competition-dependent weighting adds something beyond a constant ensemble (to be tested on B1/B2)
interpretation.adaptive_equals_static: AdaptiveMix ~ StaticMix -> competition adaptation itself has no demonstrated value (protocol section 9)
interpretation.extreme_regimes: the adaptive mixture should not clearly damage the specialist extremes (m0 for the random expert, m8 for the curriculum expert)
interpretation.next_step: freeze Amendment V2-M3.1, then prepare B1/B2 experts and mixers; B0 is never a gate
